source: This explains how a method can make much longer sequences practical without making long context “free.” DoublingZXMATH0000XZ still roughly quadruples the number of dense query-key pairs. ZXNAME0000XZ mainly attacks the data-movement and memory-footprint side of that computation.
zh: 这解释了一种方法如何能够在不使长上下文“自由”的情况下使更长的序列变得实用。将 ZXMATH0000XZ 加倍仍然使密集查询密钥对的数量大致增加四倍。 ZXNAME0000XZ 主要攻击该计算的数据移动和内存占用方面。
